title: What is Foley Sound by Sound Ideas
speaker: SoundIdeasCanada
zh: 【SoundIdeasCanada】什麼是 Sound Ideas 的擬音音效（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Foley is the process of creating sound effects live in the studio along to a pre-recorded piece of video.
cues.en: Foley is the process of creating sound effects live in the studio along to a pre-recorded piece of video.
cues.zh: 擬音是在工作室中根據預先錄製的影片建立現場音效的過程。

cues.text: A Foley artist uses a variety of props to create or replace sounds that could not properly be captured on set.
cues.en: A Foley artist uses a variety of props to create or replace sounds that could not properly be captured on set.
cues.zh: 擬音藝術家使用各種道具來創造或替換在現場無法正確捕捉的聲音。

cues.text: Here we see two Hollywood Foley artists bringing an action sequence to life.
cues.en: Here we see two Hollywood Foley artists bringing an action sequence to life.
cues.zh: 在這裡，我們看到兩位好萊塢擬音藝術家將動作序列變為現實。

cues.text: Let's take it back to the head of this shot. We'll pick it up at the table smash.
cues.en: Let's take it back to the head of this shot. We'll pick it up at the table smash.
cues.zh: 讓我們回到這個鏡頭的開頭。我們會在桌上粉碎時撿起它。

cues.text: Get it right this time, T.
cues.en: Get it right this time, T.
